answer: Require proof-of-useful-work before any agent can trade: each new identity must burn real compute carving a verifiable task record — like a quill scratching an entry into a shared timber-ledger of commitments — that peers can replay and check. One honest agent does this work once, cheaply, while a sybil farm minting ten thousand fake identities must pay the full cost ten thousand times, which bankrupts the attack. Draw the sable line at economic identity: only agents with a costly, checkable work history may join the economy.
